title: 2009 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: A three-digit integer contains one of each of the digits \(1,\) \(3,\) and \(5.\) What is the probability that the integer is divisible by \(5?\)

solutions.text:
The number is equally likely to end in \(1,\) \(3,\) or \(5.\)

It is divisible by \(5\) only if the last digit is \(5,\) which happens with probability \(\dfrac{1}{3}.\)

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: A number is divisible by \(5\) exactly when its last digit is \(0\) or \(5.\)
With digits \(1,\) \(3,\) and \(5,\) each digit is equally likely to be last.
